CITY OF PASADENA
  City Council Minutes
  July 14, 2025-5:00 P.M.
  City Hall Council Chamber

OPENING:  Vice Mayor Rivas called the regular meeting to order at 5:00 p.m.
  (Absent: Councilmembers Hampton, Madison, and Mayor Gordo)

Council Minutes  1  07/14/2025
   Colonel Avichal thanked the City Council for their kind words and
  spoke on the importance of collaborations with local partners to help
  affected communities heal and rebuild.

  Vice Mayor Rivas also presented a proclamation recognizing the
  month of July 2025 as National Parks and Recreation Month and
  Parks Make Life Better Month; and July 18, 2025 as Park and
  Recreation Professionals Day. Jennifer Colby, Communications
  Coordinator, accepted the proclamation on behalf of the Parks,
  Recreation, and Community Services (PRCS) Department, thanked
  the City Council for the recognition, and spoke on the importance of
  serving the community through recreational services. She also
  announced details for the upcoming Parks After Dark summer event
  series. Kenny James, PRCS Recreation Administrator, encouraged
  the community to engage in some type of passive recreation during
  this month, such as taking walks or enjoying picnics in one of the
  City's recreation areas. Koko Panossian, PRCS Director, extended
  his gratitude to PRCS staff for their hard work in putting together
  numerous programs, services, and events throughout the year for
  the community.

  Vice Mayor Rivas introduced Dr. Joe Coletti, CEO of Urban
  Initiatives, who spoke on the upcoming 150th anniversary of
  Colorado Blvd and 100th anniversary of Route 66. He reported that
  the Colorado Boulevard 150th Anniversary and Route 66 100th
  Anniversary Planning Council has been working with local partners
  to organize and implement various activities to commemorate these
  milestones in 2026. Pasadena Police Officers Linda Mercado and
  Adrian Wolford shared details on the 2026 Pasadena Police Classic
  Car Show, which will be a part of the festivities. Tom Coston, Light
  Bringer Project, also shared that the Pasadena Chalk Murals
  Festival will also occur during the commemoration. Mandy Prince,
  from Visit Pasadena, announced that the Great Race, a vintage car
  relay, will begin in Chicago and conclude in Pasadena. Alex Rasic,
  Gamble House Director, and Paul Little, Pasadena Chamber of
  Commerce, spoke on working with cultural and local organizations
  to build a sense of community through the celebration of these
  anniversaries. Kevin Johnson, Senior Planner, spoke on how the
  City will be assisting with the anniversary celebrations.

  Vice Mayor Rivas reported that she attended, along with
  Councilmembers Lyon and Masuda, the Pasadena Memorial Day
  Commemoration, which took place at Memorial Park on May 26,
  2025. At the event, she accepted an American flag on behalf of the
  City in honor of Pasadenans who gave their lives in service to the
  country, and noted that the Mayor and staff will find a place of honor
  for the flag to be displayed at City Hall.
